report.name: rf_stream_start
report.purpose: Configures and starts the radio's continuous RF sample data stream (typically IQ/baseband samples delivered via DMA to system memory) on the BT-side 8800D80 radio. This is an RF-subsystem entry point that arms the ADC path, enables the streaming DMA/channel, and signals the radio MAC to begin emitting samples — most likely used for calibration, factory test, or radio diagnostics paths. It belongs to the RF control subsystem of the BT firmware image and is the counterpart to a stream-stop function.

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.purpose: RF stream/channel selector (which ADC/phy path to stream from).

parameters.name: dest_addr
parameters.purpose: Destination buffer address in system RAM where streamed IQ samples are written via DMA.

parameters.name: length_or_ctrl
parameters.purpose: Stream length / control word (transfer size, mode, or packed bitfield of stream configuration flags).

return_value.meaning: 0 on success, non-negative status / negative error code on failure to start the stream.

side_effects: Writes RF control register(s) within the 0x40xxxxxx / 0x60xxxxxx radio MMIO page to arm the streaming path (registers to be confirmed — could not be read from 0x12131ac, see notes).
Programs a DMA descriptor for the stream destination buffer (DMA engine registers in the 0x60xxxxxx range).
Raises an internal event / mailbox message to the radio MAC to indicate stream-active state.
report.summary: Arms and starts a continuous RF IQ-sample data stream from the 8800D80 radio into a host/DMA buffer — the RF-subsystem 'begin streaming' entry point used by test/calibration paths.
